questions.prompt: Measure each ribbon to the nearest quarter inch. Write the lengths. Then make a line plot of your measurements on the number line.
questions.prompt_markup:
Measure each ribbon to the nearest quarter inch. Write the lengths.

questions.grading_note: Grade the parts separately: each measured length, then a line plot that matches the student's own lengths.
